title: Turtle Totem
description: This mod adds a totem in the shape of a turtle :)
body:
### Turtle Totem 🐢
The turtle totem is a new survival item that works like a totem of undying, butwith a different moddel, custom textures, different particles, different sounds and a variety of turtle related effects.

## Features
- Obtainable in survival
- Custom model textures sounds and particles
- Saves you from death
- Grants turtle related effects on use
